scope.experience: Copilot drafting and editing inside Word
scope.task: Draft a short project brief from supplied material, then revise its structure and tone while reviewing the document changes.
scope.configuration: An eligible Word subscription/account with in-app Copilot available. Human review remains required before sharing; no autonomous cross-app work is assumed.
scope.audience_perspective: A Word user creating and reviewing documents

conversational.rationale: Natural-language requests and follow-ups sit alongside an established document editor, combining dialogue with direct authoring controls.
conversational.uncertainty: The exact interaction depends on Word client version and which in-app features the account exposes.

specialization.rationale: The experience is focused on document drafting, rewriting and restructuring rather than unrestricted general chat.
specialization.uncertainty: It is specialized by workflow, not validated as an expert in a legal, medical or other professional domain.

autonomy.rationale: Copilot can carry out multi-step edits within a document from a high-level request; the user reviews and controls the finished work.
autonomy.uncertainty: No tenant-specific permissions or actual approval behavior was tested; external sharing and background agents are excluded.

accessibility.rationale: Embedding assistance in Word supports a broad office/education audience, but eligible subscriptions, accounts and document skills impose constraints.
accessibility.uncertainty: Availability varies across clients, organizations and subscriptions; audience breadth is not a disability-accessibility certification.

explainability.rationale: Users can inspect the source document and resulting edits, retaining a concrete artifact for review instead of relying only on a chat answer.
explainability.uncertainty: Visible changes and source material do not guarantee a correct rationale for every edit or full model transparency.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, human-reviewed document authoring; excludes Cowork, Autopilot and cross-app actions. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/04/22/copilots-agentic-capabilities-in-word-excel-and-powerpoint-are-generally-available/ .
